reasons: Saba deliberately selects and unties it in the Scroll Room, and its loaf-and-two-fish seal makes Nim react as if it matters.
Its ink glimmers when opened, then later settles into a drawing of five loaves and two fish, tying it to the later lunch imagery.
It recurs open between Miri and Nim in scene 15, making it more than background scroll-room dressing.
story_role: the prophetic scroll of the five loaves and two fish
